statement: For independent nearest-neighbour bond percolation on Z^d, d>=2, if 0<=p<1/(2d-1), then chi(p)<=1+2dp/(1-(2d-1)p).
assumptions: independent bonds with open probability p
source: Self-contained elementary path-counting argument; not a novelty claim.
proof: A connection 0<->x has a self-avoiding open path. There are at most 2d(2d-1)^(n-1) self-avoiding paths of length n>=1 from 0. Each specified path uses distinct bonds and has probability p^n by independence. Union bound followed by summation over endpoints and lengths gives chi(p)<=1+sum_{n>=1}2d(2d-1)^(n-1)p^n.
remaining_gap: This bound does not extend to pc. No claim concerning C0064 is made.
